description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PerformanceReviewService component of the OrangeHRM performance management plugin. It contains setup routines and multiple test cases verifying the behavior and exceptions of performance review functionalities.
external_methods: User-defined exception static methods: ReviewServiceException::activateWithoutJobTitle(), activateWithoutKPI(), pastEmployeeForReviewer(), invalidSupervisor()

classes.name: PerformanceReviewServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceReviewService in the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of PerformanceReviewService and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewDao
methods.description: Verifies that getPerformanceReviewDao() returns an instance of PerformanceReviewDao.

methods.name: testGenerateReviewReviewerRatingKey
methods.description: Checks that generateReviewReviewerRatingKey() produces the expected key string from reviewer IDs.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Tests that activateReview() throws ReviewServiceException when employee has no job title set.

methods.name: testActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Tests that activateReview() throws ReviewServiceException when employee has no KPIs set.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException1
methods.description: Verifies updateActivateReview() throws ReviewServiceException if the reviewer is a past employee.

methods.name: testUpdateActivateReviewWithException2
methods.description: Verifies updateActivateReview() throws ReviewServiceException if the supervisor is invalid.
